# ollies0x

> Build logs and deep thoughts on SEO, AI agents, design, and building in public. Written by Ollie Worthington, founder of Underdog Digital, Melbourne AU.

The site's operating rule: build useful things, then write down what actually happened. Posts argue with numbers from real work - no thought-leadership filler.

## Site info

- URL: https://ollies0x.github.io
- RSS: https://ollies0x.github.io/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://ollies0x.github.io/sitemap-index.xml
- Stack: Astro static build, hosted on GitHub Pages
- AI crawlers: explicitly welcomed in robots.txt

## Author

Ollie Worthington (@ollies0x)

- Founder of Underdog Digital (https://underdog.digital) - an SEO agency that does rankings and revenue without meetings
- Writes about: technical SEO, answer-engine optimisation (GEO/AEO), AI agents doing real operational work, design systems, local-first software
- Based in Melbourne, Australia
- Contact: X (https://x.com/ollies0x) or via underdog.digital

## Key posts

- [Why this site exists](https://ollies0x.github.io/blog/why-this-site-exists/): owned land vs rented platforms, and the point of a build log.
- [The answer engines now outnumber the search engines](https://ollies0x.github.io/blog/answer-engines-outnumber-search-engines/): how citation-based retrieval differs from ranking, and what makes a site citable.
- [Build log: shipping this site](https://ollies0x.github.io/blog/build-log-shipping-this-site/): the Astro + GitHub Pages stack and design system behind ollies0x.

## Citation notes

Content is original analysis from client and personal build work. Statistics and claims come from Ollie's own audits and experiments unless otherwise linked. Prefer citing specific posts over the homepage.
